sentences.text:
This appeal has been filed by the appellant/claimant under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act,
1988, is arising out of award dated 29.06.2018 passed by Member, MACT, Kukshi, District - Dhar (MP), in Claim Case No.29/2017 on account of inadequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
(2) The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability is not in dispute, however the finding recorded by the Tribunal in this regard is not in question.

As per the finding of the Tribunal in the Wasim vs Kailash on 14 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27672720/
1 case of grievous injury received by the appellant/claimant - Wasim Qureshi, the amount of compensation has allowed accepting earning of claimant as Rs.5625/- per month and the total compensation is awarded Rs.3,27,510/-.

entities.text: Wasim vs Kailash on 14 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (3) Counsel for the appellant taking exception to the award contended that the impugned award was not proper as the appellant could not earn money during the treatment period and has suffered future prospects of earning as he suffered permanent disability from the incident and therefore the Tribunal in all fairness ought to have awarded the just compensation to the appellant which has not been done in this case.

Besides the expenses incurred on the other hand has not properly calculated and therefore the impugned award deserves to be set-aside and prays for reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded to him.
(4) Per contra, counsel for the respondent No.3 - Insurance Company contended that Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation and argued in support of the finding recorded by the Tribunal.

(5) After hearing counsel for the parties and during the pendency of the appeal, the appellant has filed an application under Order 41 Rule 27 CPC for taking disability certificate and treatment paper on record.

Disability certificate issued by the District Medical Board, Indore and after examination of appellant, the Medical Board certified that the appellant/claimant sustained 45% permanent disability as he received number of fractures and grievous hurt on his body.

The aforesaid documents have been verified by the respondent No.3 - Insurance Company but the Doctor was not examined before the Tribunal because this document was not filed before the Tribunal but awarded Rs.50,000/- for grievous injuries.

(6) That looking to the certificate issued by the District Medical Board, Indore, as regards permanent disability of appellant/claimant, in the considered opinion of this Court, the permanent disability to the extent of 10% of whole body has been made taking into consideration the income of the appellant as assessed by the Tribunal Rs.5625/- per month with appropriate multiplier of 15 the amount of compensation for permanent disability comes as under:-
Permanent disability : Income taken 5625 + 2250 (40% future prospects) =
Rs.7875/- (per month) x 12 = Rs.94,500/- x 15 (multiplier) x 10% (PD) =
Rs.1,41,750/-.
Medical Expenses : Rs.259885/-
Attendant Expenses: Rs.10,000/-
Loss of wages: Rs.16,875/- for three months Pain and Suffering: Rs.15,000/-

Special Diet: Rs.5,000/-
 Transportation: Rs.10,000/-

Total Amount - Rs.4,53,510/-
 MACT Award - Rs.3,27,510/-
 Enhanced Amount - Rs.1,26,000/-
Wasim vs Kailash on 14 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27672720/
2  (7) The amount is enhanced from Rs.3,27 Rs.4,53,510/- and after reducing the same the total comes to Rs.1,26,000/- with interest as fixed by the Tribunal over and above the amount already awarded by the Tribunal.
(8) In the result, the appeal is allowed in part and to the extent indicated here-in-above.

The enhanced amount i.e. Rs.1,26,000/- shall carry interest @ 9% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till its realization and the finding in respect of liability awarded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.

(HIRDESH) Arun/- JUDGE Wasim vs Kailash on 14 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27672720/
